author: dtwinuz and bitg contributors
tooling: Hand-written; mirrors the justified exceptions in deny.toml and osv-scanner.toml

statements.impact_statement: glib is pulled only by tray-icon -> gtk, and tray-icon is a target.'cfg(windows)' dependency of bitg-settings. Cargo.lock lists every target, but glib is never compiled into any released artifact (MSI, .deb, .pkg, container image). bitg does not use glib::VariantStrIter.

vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2024-0370
vulnerability.description: proc-macro-error is unmaintained (informational, no known vulnerability)

statements.impact_statement: Build-time procedural macro reached only through glib-macros on the same Linux-only tray-icon -> gtk path, which is never compiled for a released artifact.
